submission_policy: Submitted PDF, Tables 1-3 and paper sheet are read-only. New measured results are additional evidence, not replacement table values.
dataset_policy: B01 is WV3 only. Each later sensor-case must also run twice on each of s1/s3/s5; no sensor-by-server partition.
automation_policy: Finite B01: RB01 and RB02 only. Stop for review after two local replicate blocks. No infinite campaign or automatic RB03 admission.

method_anchor.teacher_hash_status: Bind from actual frozen F1 package; never invent or substitute local teachers.
method_anchor.inspected_code_note: Reference inspection only; frozen source identity of the original run has to be read locally.
method_anchor.augmentation: Preserve source FH20R1 native64/16, fixed HV and rotation stream; no new augmentation, PANMIX, TTA or finetuning.

cases.name: Training-set mean reliability
cases.change: replace both geometry weights with one frozen training mean; not fixed 0.5

cases.name: q correspondence shuffle conditional on e and augmentation view
cases.change: frozen sample permutation within e quintile and view; preserve weight multiset

cases.name: Reconstruction-error surrogate with matched weight distribution
cases.change: only geometry weights use patch-mean teacher error; original hard/soft fitting unchanged

statistic_unit: 6 distinct Student seeds conditional on one fixed F1; directions/scenes/selectors/reruns are repeated measurements, not independent training repeats.
optional_historical_checks: Paper-selected checkpoints may be re-evaluated in a separate provenance/timing log; they do not fill the six new seed slots.
